description: Key fields an extractor must return for a UK public-sector contract document (Procurement Act 2023 era). Every gold.json 'fields' object uses exactly these keys. A field that does not apply to the document is null. Dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Money is a number in pounds sterling with no currency symbol or thousands separators.

fields.name: notice_type
fields.description: What kind of document this is.

fields.name: notice_reference
fields.description: Published notice identifier as printed (e.g. 004213-2026). Null for a bare contract document.

fields.name: contracting_authority
fields.description: Full legal name of the buying authority as printed.

fields.name: contracting_authority_type
fields.description: Councils are sub-central authorities; this decides the threshold row.

fields.name: supplier_name
fields.description: Awarded supplier's legal name. For a multi-lot award, the supplier of lot 1 (per-lot suppliers go in 'lots').

fields.name: supplier_registration_number
fields.description: Companies House / registration number as printed, or null.

fields.name: contract_title
fields.description: Title of the contract/procurement as printed.

fields.name: contract_reference
fields.description: The authority's own contract reference (e.g. WBC/2026/0071).

fields.name: procurement_type
fields.description: Main category. Decides the 10%/15% modification thresholds.

fields.name: light_touch
fields.description: True if the contract is a light touch contract (health, social care, education and other Schedule-listed services). Decides which threshold row applies.

fields.name: procedure
fields.description: Award procedure used.

fields.name: cpv_codes
fields.description: All CPV codes printed, 8 digits each, no check digit suffix.

fields.name: notice_published_date
fields.description: Date the notice was published.

fields.name: award_date
fields.description: Date of the award decision.

fields.name: contract_signed_date
fields.description: Date the contract was entered into (signed). Null if not stated.

fields.name: contract_start_date
fields.description: Contract commencement date.

fields.name: contract_end_date
fields.description: Initial expiry date (before any options).

fields.name: extension_options_months
fields.description: Total months of extension options available at award. 0 if none.

fields.name: maximum_term_months
fields.description: Initial term plus all extension options, in months.

fields.name: contract_value_gbp
fields.description: Total contract value as stated (for the full initial term; add options only if the document says the value includes them).

fields.name: value_includes_vat
fields.description: True if the stated value is inclusive of VAT.

fields.name: number_of_tenders_received
fields.description: Tenders received, as printed.

fields.name: kpis
fields.description: Names of the key performance indicators set for the contract, in document order.

fields.name: payment_terms_days
fields.description: Days from receipt of a valid invoice to payment, as printed.

fields.name: standstill_end_date
fields.description: Date the standstill period ends (award notices).

fields.name: lots
fields.description: One object per lot: {lot_number:int, lot_title:string, supplier_name:string|null, value_gbp:money|null, awarded:boolean}. Empty list if the contract has no lots.

fields.name: modification_number
fields.description: Sequential number of this modification to the contract.

fields.name: modification_date
fields.description: Date the modification takes effect (or was made).

fields.name: modification_description
fields.description: Short description of what is changing, as printed.

fields.name: modification_ground
fields.description: Legal ground relied on for the modification.

fields.name: original_contract_value_gbp
fields.description: Contract value before this modification.

fields.name: revised_contract_value_gbp
fields.description: Contract value after this modification.

fields.name: value_change_gbp
fields.description: Signed change in value caused by this modification (revised minus original).

fields.name: value_change_percent
fields.description: value_change_gbp as a percentage of original_contract_value_gbp, rounded to 1 dp.

fields.name: original_end_date
fields.description: End date before this modification.

fields.name: revised_end_date
fields.description: End date after this modification.

fields.name: term_change_months
fields.description: Signed change in term, in months.

fields.name: contract_change_notice_published
fields.description: Whether the document states that a contract change notice was published before the modification.

fields.name: voluntary_standstill
fields.description: Whether a voluntary standstill period is stated for the modification.

flags.description: Estimated value meets or exceeds the relevant threshold, so Part 2/3/4 of the Act apply.
Standstill ends fewer than 8 working days after the award notice was published.
Contract value above £5m but fewer than three KPIs are set.
Contract details notice published more than 30 days after the contract was entered into.
Stated payment terms exceed 30 days; the 30-day implied term applies regardless.
Modification relies on the below-threshold ground but changes value by more than 10% (goods/services) or 15% (works).
Modification changes the term by more than 10% of the maximum term at award and no Schedule 8 ground is given.
Unforeseeable-circumstances modification increases value by more than 50%.
A contract change notice was required (value change over 10%/15% or term change over 10%) but the document states none was published.
Qualifying modification to a contract over £5m: a copy of the modified contract must be published within 90 days.
Modification is dated after the contract's original end date (the contract had already expired).
Direct award of an above-threshold contract; check the s.41 justification.
